Thanks. Here's a simple code I used after my more complex code did not work. This simple one also doesn't work.

server.R :
library(shiny)
library(sp)
data(meuse)
coordinates(meuse) <- ~x+y

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  #output$dmaPlot <- renderPlot({ plot(1:10,1:10)  }) 
  output$dmaPlot <- renderPlot({ spplot(meuse, "ffreq")  }) 
})

ui.R:
library(shiny)

# Define UI for application that draws a histogram
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  # Application title
  titlePanel("Test"),
  # Sidebar with a slider input for the number of bins
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
    ),
    # Show a plot of the generated distribution
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("dmaPlot")     
    )
  )
))

Thanks,
Yuval
